title: Collaborative Partners story sequence

location.series: COLLINS / San Francisco Symphony case study
location.extent: Whole published artwork or representative frame of complete local clip

slide_intent: Introduce a group before its members because a viewer needs both the shared premise and the individual participants.
strategic_value: A rotating typographic ring followed by portraits can give the collaboration a common opening gesture.
demonstration: A social story animates Collaborative Partners in a circle, then transitions to framed portraits and names for Salonen, Reiley and Bullock.
practical_value: Use a shared animated introduction before individual profile cards.

content_islands.name: Group introduction
content_islands.spec: Place the white ring of words on the warm brown story background.

content_islands.name: Member cards
content_islands.spec: Follow with portrait cards, large variable names and smaller role descriptions inside the social frame.
